formula.footballMwp: Unadjusted game-result winning percentage; football classifications are not weighted.
formula.owp: Average opponent winning percentage with the head-to-head game removed.
formula.oowp: Average opponent OWP with the original head-to-head game removed.
formula.outOfState: Border-state opponents use direct WP and OWP; non-border-state opponents use direct WP and assigned .500 OWP.

calibrationNotes: Failed external opponent scrapes with extreme historical OWP use a clearly tracked neutral .500 estimate; successful verified sources continue to use their actual OWP.

rpiRules.nonVarsityGames: Excluded from postseason RPI; retained in historical game results.
rpiRules.verifiedFinals: Supplement missing finals without overwriting already-entered scoreboard scores.
